title: A Better Check-in at Work

words.definition_en: to take further action on something after an earlier discussion
words.example: I'll follow up with the client tomorrow morning.

words.definition_en: the latest time by which something must be finished
words.example: The deadline for the report is Friday at noon.

words.definition_en: to talk briefly with someone to share updates
words.example: Let's touch base after the meeting to align on next steps.

words.definition_en: to use all of something so that none is left
words.example: We ran out of time before we could discuss the budget.

words.definition_en: to understand or solve something after thinking about it
words.example: I need to figure out why the numbers don't match.

examples: Could you follow up on the invoice and let me know when it's approved?
We need to figure out a realistic deadline before we promise anything to the client.
Let's touch base on Monday to make sure we haven't run out of budget.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi, do you have a minute to touch base about the launch?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. I'm a little worried we might run out of time before the deadline.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Me too. Can you figure out which tasks are still open?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'll check and follow up with you by lunch.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great. Let's also agree on what we can cut if needed.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sounds good. I'll send a short summary after we talk.

quiz.question: Which sentence uses “follow up” correctly?
options: I will follow up the report tomorrow.
I will follow up with the client tomorrow.
I will follow up to the client tomorrow.
quiz.explanation_zh: follow up 通常与 with 连用：follow up with someone。

quiz.question: What does “run out of time” mean?
options: To have more time than expected
To use all the available time
quiz.explanation_zh: run out of 表示“用完”，run out of time 即“时间不够了”。

review.question: Complete the sentence: We need to ______ the meeting because the client is unavailable.
What does “in advance” mean?
review.answer: Before the expected time; ahead of time.
